Joints between bodies

Source: R/physics-mechanics-joint.R
Joint.Rd

The joints of SymPy's sympy.physics.mechanics: PinJoint() (one rotation about joint_axis), PrismaticJoint() (one translation along joint_axis), CylindricalJoint() (a rotation and a translation along the same axis), PlanarJoint() (a rotation about the parent interframe's x axis and two translations in its y z plane), SphericalJoint() (three rotations) and WeldJoint() (no motion). Each joint orients the child frame and sets the velocities of the attachment points when it is created. Joint() is the abstract base and cannot be instantiated. Attributes (coordinates, speeds, kdes, parent_point, child_point, parent_interframe, child_interframe, joint_axis and others) are reached with $.

Usage

Joint(
  name,
  parent,
  child,
  coordinates = NULL,
  speeds = NULL,
  parent_point = NULL,
  child_point = NULL,
  parent_interframe = NULL,
  child_interframe = NULL,
  parent_axis = NULL,
  child_axis = NULL,
  parent_joint_pos = NULL,
  child_joint_pos = NULL
)

PinJoint(
  name,
  parent,
  child,
  coordinates = NULL,
  speeds = NULL,
  parent_point = NULL,
  child_point = NULL,
  parent_interframe = NULL,
  child_interframe = NULL,
  parent_axis = NULL,
  child_axis = NULL,
  joint_axis = NULL,
  parent_joint_pos = NULL,
  child_joint_pos = NULL
)

PrismaticJoint(
  name,
  parent,
  child,
  coordinates = NULL,
  speeds = NULL,
  parent_point = NULL,
  child_point = NULL,
  parent_interframe = NULL,
  child_interframe = NULL,
  parent_axis = NULL,
  child_axis = NULL,
  joint_axis = NULL,
  parent_joint_pos = NULL,
  child_joint_pos = NULL
)

CylindricalJoint(
  name,
  parent,
  child,
  rotation_coordinate = NULL,
  translation_coordinate = NULL,
  rotation_speed = NULL,
  translation_speed = NULL,
  parent_point = NULL,
  child_point = NULL,
  parent_interframe = NULL,
  child_interframe = NULL,
  joint_axis = NULL
)

PlanarJoint(
  name,
  parent,
  child,
  rotation_coordinate = NULL,
  planar_coordinates = NULL,
  rotation_speed = NULL,
  planar_speeds = NULL,
  parent_point = NULL,
  child_point = NULL,
  parent_interframe = NULL,
  child_interframe = NULL
)

SphericalJoint(
  name,
  parent,
  child,
  coordinates = NULL,
  speeds = NULL,
  parent_point = NULL,
  child_point = NULL,
  parent_interframe = NULL,
  child_interframe = NULL,
  rot_type = "BODY",
  amounts = NULL,
  rot_order = 123
)

WeldJoint(
  name,
  parent,
  child,
  parent_point = NULL,
  child_point = NULL,
  parent_interframe = NULL,
  child_interframe = NULL
)

Arguments

name

Joint name.

parent, child

The parent and child bodies.

coordinates, speeds

Generalized coordinates and speeds; created with dynamicsymbols() when NULL.

parent_point, child_point

Attachment points, as points or position vectors from the mass centers.

parent_interframe, child_interframe

Intermediate frames, as frames or vectors to align with the x axis.

parent_axis, child_axis, parent_joint_pos, child_joint_pos

Deprecated arguments of SymPy.

joint_axis

The axis of rotation or translation.

rotation_coordinate, translation_coordinate, rotation_speed, translation_speed

Coordinates and speeds of a cylindrical or planar joint.

planar_coordinates, planar_speeds

The two planar coordinates and speeds of a planar joint.

rot_type, amounts, rot_order

Orientation of a spherical joint.

Value

A joint object.

Examples

P <- RigidBody("P")
C <- RigidBody("C")
J <- PinJoint("J", P, C)
J$coordinates
#> Matrix(1, 1)
#> [q_J(t)]
J$kdes
#> Matrix(1, 1)
#> [u_J(t) - Derivative(q_J(t), t)]
C$frame$dcm(P$frame)
#> Matrix(3, 3)
#> [1, 0           , 0          ]
#> [0, cos(q_J(t)) , sin(q_J(t))]
#> [0, -sin(q_J(t)), cos(q_J(t))]
